title: Oven Hot Wings (GV Wing Sections)
description: GV frozen wing sections, thawed, crisped in the oven's Air Fry mode and tossed in sauce. Cook 2 lb (about 2 to 3 servings) or all 4 lb on 2 pans.

ingredients.note: thawed (fridge Thu night; 4 lb needs about 24 to 36 hours)
optional, for crispier skin; baking powder, NOT baking soda
or a dry rub in place of the seasonings
Buffalo Wild Wings Honey BBQ, or homemade Buffalo (R8)

ingredients.item: Hidden Valley ranch and Marzetti blue cheese

steps: Pat wings very dry with paper towels. Dry skin is what makes them crisp. (Extra credit: leave them uncovered on a rack in the fridge for a few hours.)
Toss with baking powder (if using), salt, garlic powder, pepper.
Preheat oven on Air Fry mode to 425°F. Wings on a rack over a foil-lined sheet pan, skin side up, not touching.
Cook 15 to 25 min more until deep golden and the skin is crisp and crackly.
Internal temp at least 165°F; wings are best at 175 to 190°F (more tender).
Warm the sauce a little. Toss hot wings in a big bowl with sauce. Do half Honey BBQ, half Buffalo if you want both.
Serve with ranch and blue cheese.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R20
notes:
About 50 min. Ingredients are per 2 lb.
Cooking from frozen (forgot to thaw): Air Fry mode 400°F for 15 min, drain any water, pat dry, season, then 425°F 25 to 35 min, flipping halfway. Not as crisp.
Leftover cooked wings: fridge 3 to 4 days, freezer 2 months. Reheat Air Fry mode 375°F, 8 to 12 min, flip once.
